## Original problem (task)
[01274f41553299e7] (h005.task.v1)
I share a flat with two friends. We keep arguing about ordinary household chores. Sometimes we agree on who will do something, but later we disagree about what the agreement meant. Our work schedules change, and one friend has started avoiding the conversations. What should I do?

BODY
The situation describes a breakdown in coordination mechanics rather than simple unwillingness to work. Three distinct friction points appear: semantic ambiguity in agreements, dynamic constraints via shifting schedules, and psychological withdrawal by one party. Addressing the chore distribution directly may fail if the communication channel remains compromised. The avoidance behavior suggests the conversations themselves have become a source of stress, potentially outweighing the burden of the chores. A viable path forward likely requires separating the negotiation of tasks from the execution of tasks, and establishing a medium for agreement that reduces real-time pressure.

## What to return
A JSON object carrying "body" and "commitments". Both are strings and nothing else is required.
